name: Winnebago County, IL
findings: Winnebago County has 912 nonprofit organizations. 377 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 311 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Winnebago County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Economic development organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 20 economic development organizations here list membership, compared with about 9 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.
